knowledge_sources.title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 6011: The clean water in the station is insufficient, please add water, Base station clean water tank is empty, insufficient water error despite a filled tank, showed the clean water tank is empty, saying that the Clean water is insufficient, water in the clean water tank is insufficient?
knowledge_sources.content:
* 1. Inspect the components of the clean water tank itself. If there is water in the tank, remove it first: check if the sealing ring of the water outlet is installed correctly/is undamaged. If the seal ring is deformed or broken, please provide photos of the defect. 
2.If there are no abnormalities in the above steps (clean water tank components, base station sealing ring, installation), and the robot still displays error after reinstallation, it can be determined that there is a hardware problem with the base station.

knowledge_sources.title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports alert:2310 The dust collector and filter is not in place, please install the dust collector and filter, the dust box or filter is not in place?
knowledge_sources.content:
1. Take out the dust collector, open the dust collector cover, and check whether the filter is installed. If the filter is not installed, install it and try again;

knowledge_sources.title: What should I do when T2353 Omni E25/T2352 Omni E28 has 3021 Error: The sewage tank of the robot is not in place, 3021-The sewage tank of the robot is not in place, dirty water reservoir of the robot is not in place, the dirty water tank on the robot is not in place, dirty water reservoir not installed, or please install the dirty water reservoir on the robot?
knowledge_sources.content:
*I hope this message finds you well. I noticed that your machine is displaying an error indicating that the "dirty water reservoir on the robot itself is not in place." This issue may be caused by a slight misalignment of the detection sensor for the dirty water reservoir.*



*Before arranging a replacement, we have a simple temporary solution that you might want to try. The success rate for this method is relatively high if you're willing to give it a shot:*



*📝 Temporary Solution*

*You can apply a small piece of tape (regular transparent tape will work) to the right side of the back of the main robot unit. This will help secure the dirty water reservoir detection sensor in the correct position.*



*For visual guidance, please refer to the following link:*
https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/E25-E28-fixed-dirty-water-reservoir-SOP.png



*If you encounter any issues during the process or prefer not to try this temporary solution, that's completely fine, and we will provide you with the relevant warranty service.*

knowledge_sources.title: what should I do when T2080/S1 Pro has E23: Robot clean water level abnormal, task ended/Robot clean water capacity meter error/Robot clean water level sensor malfunction?
knowledge_sources.content:
1. Remove the robot from the base station, remove the robot's dirty water reservoir, flip the robot vertically 360 degrees and shake it, then return to the base station to see if it has recovered.
https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/remove-dirty-water-reservoir.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Shake-the-robot-vertically..png

2.Inspect the recharge sensors' lens where the water filling interface is located for any protrusions or damage.https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

3. We would like to confirm with you whether you have ever added third-party disinfectant or cleaning fluid directly to the base station clean water tank. After shaking the base station's clean water tank, check for foam. If foam is present, remove the base station's clean water tank, then simultaneously hold down the mode switch button and the start/pause button for 3 seconds to drain the water from the robot's clean water tank. Empty the liquid from the base station's clean water tank, refill it with tap water, and then perform the cleaning task.

knowledge_sources.title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports a warning 7002:Robot not touching the ground, please move robot to a new position, The robot is floating in the air?
knowledge_sources.content:
1. If the robot is often stuck on the edge of stairs or furniture and triggers this warning, it is recommended to set a no-go zone in the app.

2. If the robot continues to display errors on flat ground, please try restarting the robot and see if it becomes normal.

knowledge_sources.title: What should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has E41: Battery abnormal, task ended. Please try restarting or contact customer service for assistance, or shows battery error?
knowledge_sources.content:
1.Please update the robot firmware to the latest version in the APP.

2.Restart the robot and check if the robot works properly.



Applicable Models: T2080, S1 Pro

Applicable Error Codes or problem codes: E41

Core Symptoms: E41, Battery abnormal, battery error, shows smart battery has no data, battery pack data not available, displays a warning E41: Battery abnormal, task ended.

knowledge_sources.title: what should I do when T2353 Omni E25/T2352 Omni E28 has 3212 Error: Rolling mop obstructed, please clean/The roller bracket is stuck？
knowledge_sources.content:
Please follow these troubleshooting steps:



1.Remove the dirty water reservoir and check if the roller is entangled with foreign objects---especially strings, data cables, plastic bags, hair, etc. Clean out any debris to ensure the roller rotates properly. (Note:Please refer the video below. If you hear a clicking sound, it indicates that the roller is properly installed.)

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/How-to-install-a-roller-mop-for-E25-E28.mp4



Tips:

Before starting a cleaning task, tidy up cables and wires in advance to prevent roller jams.

knowledge_sources.title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports an error:2110/2111/2113 Roller brush error, or says "Abnormal roller brush"?
knowledge_sources.content:
Please try restarting the robot to check whether the error is resolved.



If the restarting could not fix the issue, our engineering team has determined that this error is caused by a hardware malfunction. Please rest assured that if your product experiences a hardware issue while still under warranty, we will provide warranty service.

knowledge_sources.title: What should I do if my X10 Pro Omni T2351 reports an error 6012 or 6013:Sprinkler error/Base station clean water pump error/Water injection device is abnormal?
knowledge_sources.content:
* 1.Please try unplugging and replugging the base station power cable. Note that after unplugging the power cable, wait 10 seconds before replugging it, and then restart the cleaning task. Observe whether the error continues.
* 2.If the error persists,our engineering team has determined that this error is caused by a hardware malfunction. Please rest assured that if your product experiences a hardware issue while still under warranty, we will provide warranty service.

knowledge_sources.title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has E4: Side brush abnormal, task ended. Please try restarting or contact customer service for assistance/Side brush error/Abnormal side brush?
knowledge_sources.content:
1. Remove the robot's dirty water reservoir, turn the robot upside down, remove the side brush, and check for any foreign objects wrapped around it.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/remove-dirty-water-reservoir.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/side-brushes.png

2. Click the Start/Pause button again to test if the robot is functioning normally.

knowledge_sources.title: what should I do when T2080 S1 pro has E53: TrueAl sensor abnormal, task ended. Please try restarting or contact customer service for assistance/A.I. sensor error/AI sensor has no data?
knowledge_sources.content:
1. Check if there is any dirt on the 3D MATRIX EYE sensor and wipe it clean with a clean, soft cloth.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/3d-Matrix-eye.png

2. Restart the robot and see if the corresponding error message disappears.

knowledge_sources.title: what should I do when T2080 S1 Pro has EB1L: The robot encountered an error while adding clean water. Task ended/Robot injecting clean water abnormally?
knowledge_sources.content:
1. Remove the clean water tank from the base station and check the seal ring of the outlet hole to ensure that it is installed correctly. Have the user shine a flashlight on the clean water tank pipe to check whether the pipe inside the clean water tank is damaged.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/the-silicone-rubber-sealing-ring-for-clean-water-outlet.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/check-the-pipe-of-clean-water-tank.png

2. Fill the water tank with clean water to the maximum water level, then ensure the water tank is securely placed in the base station.

3. Check the robot's water inlet for debris or blockages, then clean with a paper towel or cotton swab.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/water-filling-interface.png

4. After the error occurs, remove the robot from the base station and check the rubber plug at the base station's water inlet to see if there is any water. Additionally, check if the rubber plug is damaged or missing.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Silicone-for-base-station-water-injection2.png

5. Update the firmware to version 7.0.143 or higher.

knowledge_sources.title: what should I do when T2352 Omni E28 has 6063 Error: The portable deep cleaning machine is incorrectly positioned, preventing the robot from operating. Please adjust its position/The portable deep cleaning machine is incorrectly positioned?
knowledge_sources.content:
Please follow the steps below to troubleshoot:

1.Lift the portable deep cleaner, press the microswitch on the base station to check if it can press down and spring back normally. Put back the portable deep cleaner and press the dirty water tank by hand to ensure it is properly placed.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/PDC-pick-and-place.mp4

2.Check if the power plug of the base station is properly plugged in. A loose power connection may cause the machine to misinterpret that the portable deep cleaner is not properly placed.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Plug-in-the-power-cord.jpeg

Tips:

When repositioning the portable deep cleaner, make sure the hose is properly stored. Avoid pinching the power cord or bumping into walls during placement.

DO-RC1.name: 上下文丢失
DO-RC1.definition: 邮件明确提及重复提交相同信息。需要核查完整交接记录。

DO-RC2.name: 规则散落
DO-RC2.definition: 邮件明确提及同条件下政策或答复不一致。需要核查适用政策版本。

DO-RC3.name: 产品设计核查
DO-RC3.definition: 同一型号错误码重复，或不同型号同码且邮件均明确描述同类拖布阻塞症状，进入低置信度调查候选；跨型号必须分别复现，不证明共用设计缺陷。

DO-RC4.name: 过保临界点
DO-RC4.definition: 明确投诉日期位于对应 SKU 质保结束后 1–30 天。不能用今天或购买日期替代投诉日期。

DO-OPS-KNOWLEDGE.name: 知识覆盖核查
DO-OPS-KNOWLEDGE.definition: 错误码必须匹配同 PN 的公开知识标题；未匹配进入人工知识核查，不跨型号补答案。

DO-OPS-SHIPPING.name: 物流分件核查
DO-OPS-SHIPPING.definition: 物流咨询按订单和商品明细关联快照，不能把历史记录当作实时结果。

DO-OPS-WARRANTY.name: 质保日期核验
DO-OPS-WARRANTY.definition: 分别记录投诉日期与同SKU质保日期；缺日期不可推定过保集中。提示策略需由业务审核，不自动延保或推销。

DO-OPS-EMOTION.name: 情绪风险核查
DO-OPS-EMOTION.definition: 按明确投诉/愤怒词组标记邮件线索，人工复核语境；情绪不改变退款、保修资格。

DO-OPS-FOCUS.name: 高频产品抽查
DO-OPS-FOCUS.definition: 工单量用于安排抽查，不作为故障率、退货率或毛利率。
